arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE corrected transparent mermaid tail sprite. Image1 exact pixel source is absolute SILHOUETTE AND ROLL ANGLE authority. Image2 is prior draft and is MATERIAL ONLY: retain its bright lime/emerald green fin, crisp black contours, simple cel shading, small scale highlights and cyan/white water accents, but replace its incorrect repeated V pose. Source shape is a BROAD ALMOST HORIZONTAL TAIL FLUKE viewed obliquely and rolled forward, NOT an upright V. Match the first reference outline literally: the long left lobe stretches nearly horizontally to far screen-left, with just a tiny downward-curved tip; across the top is a low, mostly level bridge with only a shallow central notch. The right lobe is short and rises only slightly before rounding down at the right edge. The lower broad fin edge sweeps diagonally inward into a very THIN SHORT VERTICAL STEM that descends near the RIGHT third into the water. The fin surface reads as ONE broad flattened connected plane, asymmetrical, with left-to-right span far greater than its thickness. Do NOT create two tall leafy wings or a central upright Y. A few small white/pale-blue ripples at the bottom stem only. Smooth cartoon contours rather than stair-stepped pixel edges. Tail only, no torso/person/head, extra fin or ground, no shadows/glow, no text. Actual transparent RGBA, generous clear padding around all tips and ripple marks.
